name: SNR: The Sinner's Cookbook
author: GLMZ Inter-Corporate Security Intelligence Division
body:
This document compiles known methods of SNR (Synthetic Necrotic Reversion) deployment encountered by GLMZ security forces. Distribution restricted to security leadership.

SNR DELIVERY METHODS (documented incidents, 2220-2225):

CONTACT APPLICATION: Direct application of SNR solution to exposed skin at an implant bonding site. Requires proximity. Takes effect in 30-90 minutes. The most common method — used in 64% of documented attacks. Often delivered via handshake using an SNR-soaked adhesive patch on the attacker's palm.

INJECTION: SNR delivered via syringe or dart to the tissue near an implant site. Faster onset (15-30 minutes). Used in targeted assassinations where the goal is to disable a specific implant (usually a combat BCI or cybernetic weapon system).

AEROSOL: SNR in vaporized form, effective only in enclosed spaces with sustained exposure (10+ minutes). Low concentration but affects all exposed bonding sites simultaneously. Used in three confirmed incidents against corporate offices where multiple targets were augmented.

CONTAMINATED SNT: SNR introduced into counterfeit SNT material. The victim receives what they believe is a legitimate augmentation. The SNT bonds normally for 2-8 weeks, then the SNR component activates and dissolves the bonding layer. Delayed onset makes attribution nearly impossible. The cruelest delivery method — the victim's hope is weaponized.

FOOD/WATER: SNR is orally bioavailable at high concentrations. Ingested SNR reaches bonding sites through the bloodstream within 2-6 hours. Affects all bonding sites simultaneously. Difficult to detect at effective concentrations. Used in three confirmed mass-targeting incidents.

COUNTERMEASURES: — SNR detection patches (skin-adhesive chemical indicators) available for Φ50/pack — Prophylactic SNT stabilizer compounds (reduce SNR effectiveness by 60-80%) available by prescription — Sealed bonding site covers (physical barrier over exposed SNT margins) — recommended for high-value personnel — Awareness: the best countermeasure is knowing that SNR exists and that anyone who touches your bonding sites may be delivering it
